import pandas as pd
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression


def task_func(df, target):
    """
    Perform linear regression on a DataFrame and return the R-squared score.

    Parameters
    ----------
    df : pandas.DataFrame
        Input data containing features and target.
    target : hashable
        Name of the target column.

    Returns
    -------
    float
        R-squared score of the fitted linear regression model.
    """
    if not isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame):
        raise TypeError("df must be a pandas DataFrame")

    if target not in df.columns:
        raise KeyError(f"Target column '{target}' not found in DataFrame")

    feature_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col != target]
    if not feature_cols:
        raise ValueError("No feature columns available after removing the target column")

    data = df[feature_cols + [target]].dropna()
    if data.empty:
        raise ValueError("No complete rows remaining after dropping missing values")

    if len(data) < 2:
        raise ValueError("At least two complete rows are required to compute an R-squared score")

    X = data[feature_cols]
    y = data[target]

    numeric_X = X.select_dtypes(include=["number", "bool"])
    if numeric_X.shape[1] != X.shape[1]:
        raise TypeError("All feature columns must be numeric or boolean")

    if not pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(y) and not pd.api.types.is_bool_dtype(y):
        raise TypeError("Target column must be numeric or boolean")

    model = LinearRegression()
    model.fit(X, y)
    score = model.score(X, y)

    return float(score)
